description.name: Entry
description.text:
Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (? or ? each), grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Lightning Mode], and [Electromagnetic Rush Follow-Up] to the user
Awoken Lightning Mode: Unlimited Lightning Hones, Lightning Ability Boost & Dualcast Lightning
Electromagnetic Rush: After using Lightning abilities, chases with 6 single-target Lightning/NE ranged hybrid attacks, every 2 chases inflict single-target minor Imperil Lightning & grants Lightning Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Electromagnetic Rush Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Electromagnetic Rush after using a Lightning abiliity

description.name: Electromagnetic Rush
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (? or ? each), causes [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)] and grants [Lightning +30% Boost 1] to the user every second activation
